body.name: \(\operatorname{FID\text{-}S}\) construction handle
body.construction: Design \(\operatorname{FID\text{-}S}(G,\Omega,W,\Pi,x,y)\) by enumerating only support worlds over the supplied observed product alphabet \(\prod_{i\in V}\Omega_i\), then running support-guarded ancestral and district reductions over \(\mathcal H_{\mathrm{FS}}\), and finally lifting every terminal response obstruction source by source while preserving \(\Omega\), exact support, and the latent-source architecture of \(G\) defined in \(\mathrm{def:latent-source-architecture}\).
